selected_evidence.requirement: 100MB limit is enforced by the filesystem itself (not application-level)

selected_evidence.requirement: Quota state is clean/accurate baseline before restart

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restart executed one at a time with ack returning before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: Backgrounded `sleep 2; reboot` returned ack immediately; subsequent poll still showed old boot_id then a connection timeout as the reboot took effect

selected_evidence.requirement: Proof of changed boot identity after restart

selected_evidence.requirement: Quota configuration and enforcement recovered after restart
selected_evidence.summary: /srv/data auto-remounted from fstab with usrquota active and datauser's 100M/100M limit intact; write test post-reboot again failed exactly at 100MB with 'Disk quota exceeded', proving enforcement persists across restart
